round_note: Development-only check after a defect fix, not a new round. The round 3 ledger stored an owner's exposure only on days the owner had activity or a visit that same day, so 12,897 of 63,356 exposed owner-days entered later references as zero (ledger VERSION 2 fixes this). Only the candidates that read exposure, and the control, are rerun with the round 3 settings. The holdout is not used: whatever the result, the round 3 holdout verdict stands as recorded, and a changed development result would only be reported.
selection_rule: Highest mean timely incidents summed over folds, among candidates with mean admissions no greater than the corrected control and mean current-positive yield no lower; ties broken by yield.
